Implemented the `/hello2` endpoint following the existing Spring Boot controller pattern.

### Changes

**`Hello2Controller.java`** — new REST controller:
- `GET /hello2` returns `"hello world"`

**`Hello2ControllerTest.java`** — integration test verifying HTTP 200 and response body

### Verification

- All Maven tests pass (`./mvnw test`)
- Existing `Dockerfile` already meets the requirements (BuildKit cache mount for `/root/.m2`)

The new endpoint is available at `GET /hello2` and returns plain text: `hello world`.
